issues.legal_issue: A defendant with an interest in the subject matter and a substantial question against a co-defendant may be transposed as a plaintiff and continue the suit when the existing plaintiffs seek to withdraw.
material_facts: The suit challenged a sale of property, with the original plaintiff claiming that the property belonged to him after dissolution of a partnership.
After the original plaintiff died, his legal representatives continued the suit. One of them, acting under a power of attorney, sold the property to purchasers who were added as plaintiffs.
The other legal representatives later had that representative and the purchasers transposed as defendants, although their interest in challenging the sale deed remained.
During trial, the remaining plaintiffs sought to withdraw the suit after reaching an arrangement with the defendants who were parties to the challenged sale.
The transposed defendants objected to withdrawal and sought to continue the suit as plaintiffs, asserting a claim against the defendants to the challenged sale.
issues.conclusion: The transposed defendants were properly allowed to become plaintiffs and continue the suit against the defendants to the challenged sale; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Order XXIII Rule 1-A, read with Order I Rule 10(2) of the Code of Civil Procedure, permits a defendant to seek transposition as a plaintiff when the existing plaintiff withdraws or abandons the claim and the applicant has an interest in the subject matter and a substantial question to be decided against a co-defendant. The court's power is broad and may be exercised to enable comprehensive adjudication and avoid multiplicity of proceedings. Order I Rule 10's purpose of bringing before the court those connected with the dispute was explained in Anil Kumar Singh v. Shivnath Mishra, (1995) 3 SCC 147.

rule.if: civil_suit and plaintiffs_seek_withdrawal and defendant_seeks_transposition and applicant_has_interest_in_subject_matter and substantial_question_against_co_defendant

predicates.civil_suit: The parties brought a civil suit concerning a dispute over the subject matter.
predicates.plaintiffs_seek_withdrawal: The existing plaintiffs sought to withdraw the suit or abandon their claim.
predicates.defendant_seeks_transposition: A defendant applied to become a plaintiff in the suit.
predicates.applicant_has_interest_in_subject_matter: The defendant seeking transposition had an interest in the subject matter of the suit.
predicates.substantial_question_against_co_defendan: The defendant seeking transposition had a substantial question to be decided against another defendant.

issues.definition: When a plaintiff seeks to withdraw a civil suit, a defendant who seeks transposition and has an interest in the subject matter and a substantial question against a co-defendant may become a plaintiff and continue the suit.
